description: Activate when: someone says 'why isn't the team motivated,' 'we raised salaries but morale didn't improve,' 'people keep leaving for better opportunities,' 'employee engagement is low,' 'how do I retain engineers,' or when designing compensation, job roles, or performance systems. Do NOT activate when: the problem is a skill gap (people lack capability, not motivation); or the worker is in extreme economic precarity where basic survival income is the issue. More: deciqai.com/c/herzberg-two-factor
